subject: Asking for Fe2-S2 cluster and Molybdopterin AMBER force field parameters

messages.author: Maghsoud, Yazdan
messages.body:
Dear Amber users,
I'm working on Fe2S2 cluster and Molybdopterin residues in Xanthine Oxidase (XO). Does anyone have the parameters for any of these residues?
Best,
Yazdan
